title: PSB Sp 21 sweet potato (UPL Sp 10): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: PSB Sp 21 sweet potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: PSB Sp 21 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: PSB Sp 21 is a registered sweet potato variety, also sold or known as UPL Sp 10. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1997 as NSIC 1997 Sp 21. Its record notes 13.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Yield:** 13.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about PSB Sp 21 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 13.4 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have cream flesh and pink skin. Dry matter is 30.5 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 52.3 percent.
Where and when to plant PSB Sp 21 sweet potato

It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is UPL Sp 10 the same as PSB Sp 21?
items.a: Yes. UPL Sp 10 is another name for PSB Sp 21, registered as NSIC 1997 Sp 21. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
The record shows 13.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of PSB Sp 21?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
